entities.summary: Captain Nikolai Frantsevich Gastello was a Soviet aviator and a Hero of the Soviet Union. He is one of the best known Soviet war heroes, being the best known Soviet pilot, who according to Soviet propaganda, conducted a "fire taran" – a suicide action by the pilot of an aircraft on fire, flying into a target with the intention of setting it alight.
